definitions: A venomous snake of the subfamily Crotalinae, characterized by a heat-sensing pit organ located between the eye and the nostril on each side of the head.
Any snake belonging to the subfamily Crotalinae, which includes rattlesnakes, copperheads, and cottonmouths.
examples: Many species of Pit Viper are found in the Americas.
The bite of a Pit Viper can be dangerous.
